acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks to Jay Van Bavel, who recently found himself trapped in an elevator (in a very 2020 predicament).

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: A few weeks ago, Jessica and Moisés found themselves hiding in an attic. Reporter Kevin Sieff talks to them about how they got there.
acts.title: The People Up the Stairs

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: The musicians in the orchestra for Phantom of the Opera tell reporter Jay Caspian Kang about what it’s like to play the exact same music every single night—for decades—and how they’ve learned to make their peace with it.
acts.title: Music of the Night after Night after Night
